description: This file implements a Timer class and a factory for creating Timer instances, including thread management and callback execution, within the firebolt::rialto::common namespace.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class representing a timer that executes a callback after a specified timeout, supporting periodic execution and thread management.

classes.name: ITimerFactory
classes.description: An interface for a factory that creates Timer instances.

classes.name: TimerFactory
classes.description: A concrete implementation of ITimerFactory that creates Timer objects and manages a singleton factory instance.

methods.name: ITimerFactory::getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton TimerFactory instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: TimerFactory::createTimer
methods.description: Creates a new Timer object with specified timeout, callback, and timer type.

methods.name: Timer::Timer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Timer object and starts its thread based on the provided timeout and callback.

methods.name: Timer::~Timer
methods.description: Destructor that cancels the timer and joins the thread.

methods.name: Timer::cancel
methods.description: Stops the timer and joins the thread if it is running.

methods.name: Timer::isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.
